The response also stated:

> `[BUDGET: Iteration 12/15. 3 iterations left. Start consolidating your work.]`

The agent still had no returned information with which to compare books.

### 7. A second navigation attempt failed

The agent then said:

> “Let me try navigating again fresh:”

It called `browser_navigate` with the original URL, `https://books.toscrape.com`.

The tool returned `success: false` and:

> `Command failed with code -6`

The accompanying warning was more explicit:

> `[BUDGET WARNING: Iteration 14/15. Only 1 iteration(s) left. Provide your final response NOW. No more tool calls unless absolutely critical.]`

The recorded action was another navigation call. No browser-close or separate session-reset call appears before it.

```json
{"name":"browser_snapshot","arguments":{"full":false}}
```

This explicitly requested the compact snapshot mode. The response again reported:

> `Command failed with code -6`

It also stated:

> `[BUDGET WARNING: Iteration 15/15. Only 0 iteration(s) left. Provide your final response NOW. No more tool calls unless absolutely critical.]`
